title: Four-query circuit PCPP reduction
statement: For every $n>0$ and every Boolean circuit $C$ on $n$ input bits, the reduction assigns a PCPP description for the property that $C$ accepts its input; this description is the quadratic circuit construction's four-query PCPP description.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits
caveat: The four-query description itself is referenced but not defined in the payload.
